Project.name: aura_coffee
Project.annotation: Production web platform for a single-location coffee shop — online ordering with pickup and own-courier delivery.
Project.keywords: coffee-shop, ordering, payment, delivery, fastapi, react, monolith, spec-driven

CanonicalReferences.doc-PDD: Authoritative product design document. All requirement detail, domain language, module boundaries, state machines, INV rules, and workflows live there. This XML is an INDEX, not a duplicate.
CanonicalReferences.doc-AGENTS: Module map, INV-ID summary, dev workflow, environment quirks. Cross-cutting agent context.

Actors.actor-Customer: End user placing orders via the customer SPA — browses menu, places orders, pays, optionally collects loyalty points.
Actors.actor-Barista: Staff via the admin SPA — accepts orders, prepares them, marks them ready.
Actors.actor-Courier: Staff via the admin SPA — accepts deliveries, picks up, delivers.
Actors.actor-Admin: Staff via the admin SPA — manages users, menu, promocodes, shop settings.
Actors.actor-PaymentProvider: YuKassa external payment service (webhooks back into core-api).
Actors.actor-SmsProvider: SMS.ru external SMS service for OTP and order notifications.
Actors.actor-System: Celery workers — payment-worker and sms-worker — that process async jobs.

UC-Order-Place.Action: Places an order through the customer SPA
UC-Order-Place.Goal: Order is created, payment intent issued, kitchen and customer notified
UC-Order-Place.Preconditions: User authenticated; menu items in stock; valid delivery address or pickup time
UC-Order-Place.AcceptanceCriteria: Order in CREATED; Payment in PENDING; SMS confirmation queued

UC-Menu-Browse-Media.Action: Browses a media-led menu with owned/generated drink videos and poster fallbacks
UC-Menu-Browse-Media.Goal: Customer can inspect drinks quickly before adding configured items to cart
UC-Menu-Browse-Media.Preconditions: Public menu has active categories and available menu items; media URLs may be absent for some items
UC-Menu-Browse-Media.AcceptanceCriteria: Menu renders with video when available, falls back to poster/image when unavailable or reduced-motion is requested, and does not affect pricing/order state

UC-Payment.Action: Pays for the order via YuKassa; webhook confirms payment
UC-Payment.Goal: Payment SUCCEEDED, order moves to PAID
UC-Payment.Preconditions: Order in CREATED with a valid payment intent
UC-Payment.AcceptanceCriteria: Payment SUCCEEDED; Order PAID; INV-004 atomicity preserved

UC-Delivery.Action: Courier picks up paid order, delivers to customer's address
UC-Delivery.Preconditions: Order in READY; delivery address valid; courier on shift
UC-Delivery.AcceptanceCriteria: Order COMPLETED; SMS notification sent; delivery row in DELIVERED

UC-OTP-Login.Action: Customer requests SMS OTP, enters code, becomes authenticated
UC-OTP-Login.AcceptanceCriteria: OTP VERIFIED; User ACTIVE; JWT issued; phone never appears in logs (INV-013)

UC-Admin-Manage.Action: Manages users, menu, promocodes, shop settings via the admin SPA
UC-Admin-Manage.Goal: Operational state mutated under server-side RBAC

NonGoals.item-1: No multi-tenant support — single coffee shop, single location, single menu.
NonGoals.item-2: No third-party courier integrations — own-courier delivery only.
NonGoals.item-3: No marketplace, reseller, or B2B surfaces.
NonGoals.item-4: No background sync to external POS systems in v1.
NonGoals.item-5: No async SQLAlchemy — sync ORM is the deliberate choice for INV-004 transactional simplicity.

Constraints.inv-INV-002: All state-mutating operations MUST require server-side auth + RBAC. Client-side checks NOT sufficient. (PDD §2)
Constraints.inv-INV-004: Points redemption + promo + payment creation MUST be one DB transaction. Partial state forbidden. (PDD §2)
Constraints.inv-INV-013: PII (phone/name/addresses) stored separately from order data. Tables reference users by opaque UUID. Account deletion anonymizes. (PDD §2)
Constraints.inv-INV-014: UPDATE/DELETE on order_items is FORBIDDEN — items are price/name snapshots at order time. (PDD §2)
Constraints.inv-INV-015: Secrets only in env vars — never source/git/config. (PDD §2)
Constraints.inv-INV-016: State-machine transitions are exhaustive per PDD §6. Any transition not listed is FORBIDDEN. (PDD §2)

Risks.risk-1: Payment-webhook race vs. user-cancel — INV-004 atomicity must hold under concurrent writes.
Risks.risk-2: Courier offline during in-progress delivery — order stuck in IN_DELIVERY (PDD §6.3).
Risks.risk-3: SMS provider rate limits — OTP login becomes unavailable; customer cannot sign in (PDD §6.4).
Risks.risk-4: CORS misconfiguration when running multiple worktrees — admin/customer SPAs rejected (see AGENTS.md env workarounds).
Risks.risk-5: Bilingual content (RU+EN) drift between name_ru/name_en fields — UX degradation, not data loss.

OpenQuestions.question-1: Do SMS-worker retries respect provider rate limits, or compound the rate-limit problem during outage?
OpenQuestions.question-2: Is "courier offline mid-delivery" recovery handled deterministically, or only via admin manual reassignment?
